scope: Metadata-only primary-documentation expansion; no cookie values or remote runtime fetching

exclusions.reason: Shared _pk_id/_pk_ses/_pk_cvar names cannot distinguish owners by name alone; existing attribution must not be silently overridden.
mp_<token>_mixpanel requires both prefix and suffix; prefix-only mp_ would misattribute unrelated site cookies.
Generic sp collector cookie omitted because arbitrary custom collector domains are not identifiable from its name alone.
Authoritative per-cookie public product documentation not verified in this pass; community records remain candidates.
Explicit localStorage/sessionStorage entries were excluded from physical-cookie rules.
Mixed-purpose dynamic prefixes retain category unknown where the current matcher cannot distinguish suffix semantics.
Public vendor site table supports akamai.com only, not all-domain bot-security semantics or token decoding.
